elements_selected.content: Add 'zetl view [<page>] [--context-lines <N>] [--main-width <pct>]' subcommand to the clap CLI in src/cli.rs. Validate arguments: --context-lines must be 1–20; --main-width must be 30–80. Before launching ViewApp: check stdin is a TTY (use crossterm::terminal::is_raw_mode_enabled or libc isatty()); if not, exit with error code NOT_A_TTY and JSON error message. Render the status bar at the bottom of the terminal showing: 'zetl view │ <page_title> │ <mode> │ [focused_link] │ N links │ j/k scroll  Tab focus  ?'. Implement '?' key to show a keybindings help overlay listing all keybindings from CON-023. Implement 'q' and Ctrl-C to restore terminal and exit 0. Implement Ctrl-R to toggle full-screen context pane overlay in single-pane mode. REQ-062, CON-023.
